title: A change to one bl_ module selects only the tests that import the backlog modules
goal: testmap.py select for a change to _tools/bl_land.py selects fewer than 60 test files (today 104 of 127), because the import chain through conftest.py -> kbpublic -> ql_deliver -> backlog that pulls every backlog module into most tests is cut or deferred (find the real chain with testmap deps first); the full run at sprint end still covers everything. Planted test: select for bl_land.py stays under the bound and a file that really imports it is still selected.

run: import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/testmap.py','select','--paths','_tools/bl_land.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; n=sum(1 for l in o.splitlines() if 'test_' in l); sys.exit(0 if n<60 else 1)

gates.question: testmap deps shows the chain the goal names (conftest -> kbpublic -> ql_deliver -> backlog) is not the only one: select for bl_land.py is 84 test files, 45 of them import backlog or bl_land themselves, and getting under 60 needs three changes together (measured): ql_deliver off the backlog facade (onto bl_base, bl_intake, bl_ci), bl_ci no longer importing bl_land (run_check moved below it: bl_ci.py, bl_land.py and bl_base.py outside the touches), and testmap no longer following the imports of a script a module only names as a string (kg_sync's backlog.py check, kb_hook, kbdecide, bl_base's review checks): 45 files. Any two of the three leave 70 or more. Which?
options: all three: widen the touches to bl_ci.py, bl_land.py, bl_base.py and test_layout.py; a module that runs a script by name then selects that script's own tests, not its imports', and the full run at sprint end covers the rest
only ql_deliver and bl_ci (testmap's rule stays): the bound is not reached (about 70); lower the item to that
drop the item: 84 is the conservative map, the sync gate keeps it
gates.recommendation: all three: widen the touches to bl_ci.py, bl_land.py, bl_base.py and test_layout.py; a module that runs a script by name then selects that script's own tests, not its imports', and the full run at sprint end covers the rest
